properties.rationale: Standing disposition for planned-but-unbuilt capabilities, with a caveat that matters more here than usual: this capability is semantic, so a deterministic test can only pin its GUARDS, never its judgement. What must be asserted is that a suggested requirement enters at `proposed` and never higher, that it is attributed to inference rather than to the user, and that nothing downstream treats it as intent until a human confirms it. Whether the suggestions are any GOOD is a trials question, not a test one. The failure to guard against is a tool that quietly invents requirements and then reports them as the design — which would violate dec:human-decides more seriously than any gap it closed.
